metadata.title: The Khronon Route: the Blanchet-Skordis Theory Through Two Gates, and Why No Kinetic Function Repairs It
metadata.description:
Version 2 corrects version 1. Version 1 presented a cubic, one-scale khronon as a repair that passes cosmology and KiDS. It does not. At the parameters that passed cosmology, the cubic term dominates the static equation in galaxies (the kinetic-sector density exceeds the MOND phantom by 1e8-1e12 at 10 kpc), and MOND ends at 1-4 kpc. The repair is withdrawn.

The relativistic khronon theory of Blanchet and Skordis (JCAP 11 (2024) 040) is run, on its own equations, through the two gates that closed this programme's previous completion (PAPER32).

Moving source: passed. The phantom is a conserved fluid carried by the aether, and a galaxy moving uniformly with its phantom is an exact post-Newtonian solution. The costs: the phantom is assembled rather than generated, it follows velocity changes only inside r ~ 2GM_b/du^2, and the static halo is stable only for a monotone phantom law.

KiDS and sigma_8: failed. The MOND function reads the gradient of the khronon's own potential. The benchmark mu^-1 = 22.3 Mpc puts 24x the KiDS-1000 bound on it; the benchmark 223 kpc ends MOND-like lensing at ~80 kpc. The theory's own scale-dependent sound speed gives linear sigma_8 ~ 0.21-0.26.

The identity. For any kinetic function K(Q), the static galactic mass term and the khronon's late Jeans scale are one scale: mu_eff^2 = k_J^2 (1 + c_ad^2), exactly. KiDS's field bound needs it below 0.22 Mpc, while MOND-like lensing to 1 Mpc needs it above ~10 Mpc. The khronon-as-dark-fluid aether is therefore closed by KiDS for every K.

The mass budget. With CDM-like accretion, a conserved phantom of a KiDS lens runs out at 0.13-0.67 Mpc, inside the clean 0.3 Mpc range for most lens masses.

What stands. A one-scale MOND function J = Lambda j(Y/Lambda) makes a0 = kappa c sqrt(G rho_Lambda) an identity of the action, with kappa = 2 sqrt(8 pi)/(3 beta); kappa is not derived. The design lesson is that the MOND function must not read the acceleration of the cosmological dark fluid. AI-assisted research programme; not peer reviewed; nothing is claimed closed.
